records.question: What did the coral reef workshop in American Samoa conclude?
records.ground_truth_answer: It concluded that our coral reefs are seriously over-fished, and that "live rock" provides food and habitat for coral reef fish.

records.question: Who must permit the export of cultured live rock and under what requirement?
records.ground_truth_answer: The Department of Marine and Wildlife Resources must permit the export of cultured live rock in accordance with administrative rules and regulations which that department shall promulgate.
ground_truth_chunks: (b) Export of any live rock taken from reefs is prohibited.
